commits.headline: fix(difficulty): copy the enemies the level places, whatever part of the story they are for, version 1.1.1
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The enemy count copied none: it left out every placement whose flags have
bit 0 or 1 set, read as tied to a mission, but those bits only say whether
the moby is placed before its planet's mission is done, after it or both,
and nearly every enemy on both discs has one (all 16 of Veldin's horny
toads; the log's "0 copies of 25 enemies" counted only its pterodactyls,
which are never copied). The load already leaves out those of the other
part of the story, so the flags no longer count, for copies…

commits.headline: feat(keyboard-mouse): the mouse turns the camera directly, version 1.2.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: The mouse no longer acts as the right stick for the follow camera and the first-person view: a tick's motion turns the view by an angle in proportion to it, that same tick, with none of the stick's easing, and regardless of the game's own invert options (mouse right turns right, mouse up looks up; the mod's Invert setting still flips Y). The follow camera is turned from its hook point by writing its orbit, smoothed orbit and eye, and its tilt is held through the game's own target; the…

commits.headline: feat(ammo-max): buying ammo starts at the most you can buy, version 1.0.0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The vendor's buy dialog starts its count at 1. After each tick the mod
reads the dialog's state and, the tick it opens on ammo the game lets Up
raise, sets the count to the most Up would reach: the rounds the weapon
has room for or the bolts pay for. Down still lowers it. No hook point:
the dialog's globals on both discs. Tests for the count and the library
on a vendor laid out at each disc's addresses.

commits.headline: feat(difficulty): copies use a bigger moby pool, Gaspar's too, keeping a console's 255 for the sparks
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
OpenRAC's port now gives most levels 767 spare moby slots instead of 255
(all but Rilgar, Blarg Station and Quartu). The mod already reads the
pool's bounds from the game after each load, so the copies' budget grows
by itself (free slots less the 160 kept for the game: 607 instead of 95).

Gaspar's rule was tied to a console's pool: no copies, because the lava
sparks nearly fill 255. It now keeps those 255 for the sparks on top of the
reserve, which gives no copies in a pool of 255, as before,…
